description.translate: My old master swore a good craftsman could make a useful tool from almost anything. Let's see what you've got. Bring me twelve flint. We'll start with the basics before worrying about molten metal and fancy machinery.

Not bad. You've got the patience for proper toolmaking. The Ranker asked me to forge a sword that could hold an enemy's power. Tears for Fears was that sword. He promised to help restore this forge when the research was finished. You are doing the work he left waiting.
